tools.name: detect_feed_format
tools.description: Detect whether a supplied hotel or catalog feed payload is JSON, NDJSON, XML, CSV or TSV before parsing or validation.

tools.name: normalize_hotel_feed
tools.description: Parse a hotel feed and normalize common supplier or platform aliases into a canonical hotel-record shape without changing the source payload.

tools.name: validate_feed
tools.description: Validate a supplied static hotel or catalog feed against one selected platform rule pack or the generic hotel master-data audit.

tools.name: validate_wego_hotel_feed
tools.description: Validate a static hotel feed against Wego-oriented published requirements and data-quality checks.

tools.name: validate_google_hotel_center_list
tools.description: Validate a Google Hotel Center Hotel List static feed, including identifiers, address, country and phone or geo requirements.

tools.name: validate_trivago_hotel_data
tools.description: Validate CSV or JSON hotel inventory against trivago FastConnect's published Hotel Data requirements.

tools.name: validate_meta_catalog
tools.description: Check a hotel or travel catalog for Meta mapping and catalog readiness. This is not official Meta certification.

tools.name: validate_criteo_catalog
tools.description: Check a product or travel catalog for Criteo import readiness, content coverage, IDs, URLs and images.

tools.name: validate_hotel_master_data
tools.description: Run a platform-independent hotel master-data quality audit.

tools.name: compare_feed_readiness
tools.description: Run the same static feed through multiple platform rule packs and compare readiness scores, errors, warnings and validation issues.

tools.name: compare_platform_requirements
tools.description: Compare documented or readiness-oriented field requirements across supported hotel and catalog platforms before designing a feed mapping.

tools.name: suggest_feed_fixes
tools.description: Validate a supplied feed for one target and turn deterministic validation issues into remediation actions for the affected records.
